name: C077 Kẻ Trao Đổi Mệnh (Quyền Trượng Thiên Bình Sinh Mệnh)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of an Epic dark-fantasy Soul-Balancer's scale of life scepter staff (Quyền Trượng Thiên Bình Sinh Mệnh - C077 Kẻ Trao Đổi Mệnh) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete balance-scale staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (fluted antique gold and dark ironwood shaft) to top-right (an ornate golden balance beam crosspiece suspending two glowing crystal chalices filled with equalized emerald-and-gold life essence connected by a luminous spirit bridge).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top twin-scale crest with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use burnished gold, dark ironwood, silver chains, and glowing emerald-turquoise & golden vitality light).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_anim_2x2:
Create a 2x2 sprite sheet (4 frames total: row 1 left-to-right, row 2 left-to-right) of the EXACT SAME Scale of Life Balance Staff from the first attached reference image, following the 2x2 grid layout of the second attached reference image (layout_guide_2x2.png).

100% CONSISTENCY & ANIMATION RULES:
- Every cell must show the exact same diagonal golden balance-scale staff at the exact same angle, size, and position.
- Animate a looping 4-frame spirit-equilibrium aura: streams of emerald-and-gold life energy flowing back and forth between the two suspended chalices with glowing sacred geometry rings.
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) in all 4 cells. DO NOT draw the blue layout guide lines or cell borders. Keep each frame strictly inside its cell with zero clipping.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Scale of Life Balance Staff (Quyền Trượng Thiên Bình Sinh Mệnh - C077 Kẻ Trao Đổi Mệnh) from the attached reference images.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the golden balance-scale staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a sacred temple hall where arcs of emerald-and-gold soul energy link multiple spirit vessels in perfect equilibrium around the staff.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
